rows.description: Enjoys an unseen head pat: leans, closes eyes, returns.
Smooths hair, touches the headband, lowers hand.
Raises hands, claps, separates palms, lowers hands.
Smooths apron, looks at attached whale tail as it sways, returns.

review.identity: Original costume, ears, eyes, headband, whale emblem and attached tail preserved.
review.dimensions: Use actual source dimensions and rounded quarter-cell boundaries.
review.constraints: No external hand, text, background or added prop.
